name: Falcon
summary: Models from Abu Dhabi's TII research institute, notable for publishing training data details alongside weights.
description:
Falcon earned trust by being unusually transparent: refiner weights with known training data provenance, technical reports that describe the mixture, and small variants intended for fine-tuning rather than for show. Teams building a domain-specific model with a need to document how the base was made have a real advantage choosing this lineage.

The ecosystem around it is smaller than Llama's, so quantisations, serving recipes and community fine-tunes appear more slowly, and the top-end capability race has been won elsewhere. It is a strong pick when documentation and control matter more than having the largest number of people already running it.
